name: Lukas Hoffmann
headline: Lead AI/ML Engineer
summary: Lead AI/ML Engineer with 10 years of experience designing and deploying scalable machine learning systems and generative AI applications. Skilled in building production-grade MLOps pipelines on GCP and orchestrating multi-agent LLM workflows using LangGraph. Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams to deliver reliable, maintainable AI solutions.

responsibilities: Lead a team of 6 ML engineers building generative AI products for enterprise clients
Architect multi-agent LLM pipelines using LangGraph for automated document processing
Design and maintain MLOps infrastructure on GCP including CI/CD for model deployment
Define technical roadmap and mentor junior engineers on best practices
Collaborate with product managers to translate business requirements into ML solutions
Developed NLP models for customer support automation, reducing manual ticket handling
Built and maintained feature pipelines and model monitoring dashboards
Migrated legacy ML workflows to GCP-based infrastructure
Implemented automated retraining pipelines using Airflow and Kubeflow
Built predictive models for demand forecasting in retail clients
Developed data preprocessing and feature engineering pipelines
Collaborated with data engineers to productionize models using REST APIs
Conducted model evaluation and performance tuning
